info.name: Velure E-commerce API
info.description: Run the folders in order (Runner works). Set adminEmail/adminPassword to the values in backend/.env. Tokens are stored automatically by the login requests' test scripts.

item.name: Register - tries to set role=admin (still a customer)

exec: pm.test('token returned, no password in user', function () { pm.expect(j.token).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(j.user).to.not.have.property('password'); });

request.description: Uses the ADMIN_EMAIL / ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env. Edit the collection variables.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.content.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', j.content[0].id); }
